environment: Exact candidate Web build against a disposable restored database migrated through 135, with 13 synthetic registered private assets and two synthetic accounts; no agent worker running

results.ownerActualPage: After selecting the second-page 921-character-title asset, the desktop composer sent one message with exactly that asset ID in attachments.
results.ownerActualApi: POST /api/assistant/messages returned 202 and a queued run.
results.database: The queued agent_run belonged to the owner and persisted exactly the selected asset ID in input.attachments.
results.crossAccount: The other logged-in account could not list the asset. A forged POST naming its asset ID returned 409 and created zero agent_run rows for that account.

limits: The asset was synthetic registered metadata with no original upload or extracted content. This proves submission binding and cross-account rejection at the queued API path, not worker-time content access, answer quality, real upload/retry, production load or rollback.
